raw_llm_output: Target well 15/9-F-9A exhibits CRITICAL STUCK PIPE risk (80%) at current drilling depth with indicators of survey recorded in offset logs [SNIPPET_SYNTH-W09_2011-01-20_STUCK_PIPE]. Historical logs from analog well SYNTH-W26 demonstrate survey and stationary across depth-correlated stratigraphy [SNIPPET_SYNTH-W26_2011-03-12_STUCK_PIPE]. GraphRAG event logs capture survey requiring immediate rig-floor monitoring of torque and differential pressure [SNIPPET_SYNTH-W09_2010-01-25_STUCK_PIPE]. Wilson 95% confidence interval spans [0.4902, 0.9433], demonstrating analog variance where 8 of 10 offsets suffered similar survey [SNIPPET_SYNTH-W34_2011-08-03_STUCK_PIPE]. The rig crew must maintain standard monitoring and verify mud properties to counter documented survey hazards before progressing further [SNIPPET_SYNTH-W09_2011-01-20_STUCK_PIPE].
